definitions.explanation: A kitchen appliance with burners used for cooking on top of.

examples.japanese: コンロで{湯|ゆ}を{沸|わ}かす。
ガスコンロの{火|ひ}を{消|け}し{忘|わす}れた。
examples.english: I forgot to turn off the gas stove.

examples.japanese: {台所|だいどころ}には３{口|くち}コンロがある。
examples.english: The kitchen has a three-burner stove.

notes:
コンロ derives from the Dutch word 'komfoor' (portable stove).

TYPES:
- ガスコンロ (gas stove)
- IHコンロ (induction cooktop)
- {電気|でんき}コンロ (electric stove)
- {卓上|たくじょう}コンロ (portable stove)
- {七輪|しちりん} (traditional charcoal stove)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コンロの{火|ひ}をつける (to turn on the stove)
- コンロの{火|ひ}を{消|け}す (to turn off the stove)
- コンロを{掃除|そうじ}する (to clean the stove)
- ～{口|くち}コンロ (X-burner stove)

In Japan, ガスコンロ has been traditional, but IHコンロ (induction) is becoming popular due to safety and ease of cleaning.
